field_notes.pattern: Sticker map of the case exactly as held before executing algs[0] (computed by simulation). OLL: "top" is 9 chars, rows back->front, columns left->right; X = U-colour sticker. front/right/back/left are the 3 top-layer stickers of that side read left-to-right as you face that side. PLL: letters are the home face of each sticker colour (F,R,B,L), same reading order.
field_notes.mirror_of: Case solved by the left-right mirror (R<->L) of algs[0], computed by simulation.
field_notes.inverse_of: Case solved by the inverse of algs[0], computed by simulation. For OLL this is alg-specific (a different alg for the same case can invert to a different OLL); for PLL it is case-level.
field_notes.alg_details: Per-alg provenance; speedcubedb_votes = community votes on the SpeedCubeDB category page at fetch time (2026-10-28).
field_notes.verification: Every alg was simulated: it solves exactly this case (matched against SpeedCubeDB's setup scramble for the case, up to AUF), preserves F2L, and (PLL) preserves LL orientation. Parentheses from sources were stripped; no other edits. Case identity was cross-checked three ways: J Perm algs, SpeedCubeDB setups/algs, and every alg in Feliks Zemdegs' CubeSkills PDFs (all 78 cases agree).

two_look_edge_step.description: 2-look OLL step 1 (orient edges, ignore corners). Step 2 is the 7 OCLL cases (two_look=true). Source: J Perm 2-look OLL.
